verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an official MCP integration that lets any MCP-compatible agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) use it as a web search tool, which delivers the 'ready-made tool' core. A community thread corroborates the hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.serpapi.com/mcp with Bearer auth. LLM-optimized markdown output also supports agent consumption, but the evidence shows no explicit function-calling schemas and no named agent-framework integrations beyond MCP, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. missing for 10: documented function-calling/tool JSON schemas, integrations with agent frameworks beyond MCP (e.g. framework tool wrappers), an OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call quality

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the API into an agent as a ready-made tool, with function-calling schemas and agent-framework integrations designed for direct tool-call consumption

citations.quote: The MCP integration allows any MCP-compatible AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) to use SerpApi as a web search tool.
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/serpapi/serpapi-mcp
Serve any SerpApi search result as clean markdown. Same data as JSON, zero configuration, roughly half the tokens. Works with every API.
